description: DO serverless inference model catalog in the platform inference.models[] schema (OpenRouter-style). Generated from GET /v1/models and DO docs pricing/models pages. Pricing values are per-token decimal strings (divide DO per-1M docs values by 1,000,000). Fields the platform requires but DO does not publish (capacity_tpm, some hugging_face_id, license) are either sourced from upstream model cards or explicitly set to null.
